# LLODE

> LLODE is creative experiment infrastructure for performance brands. It connects a test question, an experiment plan, observed evidence and a bounded next decision.

Plan one-variable creative tests, keep controls fixed, and connect recorded results to the next experiment. LLODE helps brands decide what to change next.

Brief defines the variable, fixed controls and measurement plan. The brand runs its advertising activity using its existing execution tools. Run connects the plan to submitted observations. Record preserves the comparison and the supported action: Adopt, Retain, Continue or Rerun. A positive metric change alone does not establish a winner.

The Decision Router connects the recorded decision to a next test question and its fixed conditions. Review supports or challenges the question, not the winner. Benchmark context depends on comparable, consented evidence and privacy thresholds. Illustrative samples are not live peer evidence. Linking decisions and follow-up outcomes is the foundation of an experiment registry.

Calibrated prediction is a longer-term direction, not a current promise of expected lift, ROAS, ROI or winner probabilities. LLODE is not an ad agency, creative production tool or media-buying service.

The product workspace requires authorized access. This public summary contains no customer data, private records or internal engine implementation.
